paragraphs.text: Jyoti is legendary ancient elemental from the plane of Moag .

Jyoti debuted as a character in Modern Horizons 3 Commander as part of the Tricky Terrain deck. It has a bond with the Dryads of the plane and creates Forest Dryad land creature tokens to represent them while also buffing land creatures. Jyoti appears as a large walking being similar to a golem, comprised of stone and vegetation.
